card.name: Scattered plural nouns and word endings
card.fires_on: Mixed: plural nouns like quizzes and glaciers, and endings inside split words such as altered, utely and ures. Also a few stray punctuation marks.

modes.label: Plural nouns
modes.description: Plural nouns such as quizzes or glaciers, often in web text about climate or games.

modes.label: Stray symbols
modes.description: A colon or broken character at the start of a line or inside a fraction.

card.writes: Promotes endings like 'ster' and 'sters' but the pattern is weak, so no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on a loose mix of plural nouns and pieces of split words, with no single theme.
